topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the core themes of the lecture and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal expansion and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies, cellular plasticity, and cancer stem cell models explain tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental drivers and integrated cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how microenvironmental and inflammatory signals permit malignant outgrowth, how these spatial interactions are experimentally mapped, and how they integrate into a comprehensive evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
